description: This file defines the Cost model class for projects in the Goteo funding platform, including methods for retrieving, validating, saving, and deleting cost entries associated with projects.

classes.name: Cost
classes.description: Represents a cost item related to a project, with properties for cost details and methods for CRUD operations and validation.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields that support language-specific content.

methods.name: setLang
methods.description: Sets language-specific data for the cost, associating it with a project.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cost record by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all cost records associated with a specific project, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the cost object to ensure required fields are set properly.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the cost object to the database, inserting or updating as needed, and recalculates project costs.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes this cost from the associated project.

methods.name: types
methods.description: Returns an array of supported cost types with their localized labels.
